# Vendored third party assets

Each file below was downloaded from `source`, verified as described, and its
sha384 recorded. The same hash is carried in the `integrity` attribute of the
tag that loads it, so a modified file on disk is refused by the browser.
To update a library: replace the file, recompute the hash, update the tag and
this manifest.
